note: fix: a second archive location (persvati) that evidence_store.py put writes when hbox is unreachable; a reconcile step copies to hbox and verifies by hash when it returns; the index line (sha256, bytes, logical path) is the same either way. Observed: train 20's regen refused at cite (ssh exit 255 to hbox:/tank/fn/evidence); chain_schedule on persvati paid an ssh timeout per uncached manifest until the laptop cache was seeded.
notes: Closed as superseded (lane evidence-two-site, 2026-10-08): origin/dev 17c84c937 (evidence delete (2), 2026-10-07 19:11 -0400) deleted tools/evidence_store.py, evidence_manifests.py, evidence_history.py, evidence_ingest.py and planning/evidence-index.tsv; farm/certify_books no longer archive manifests (the run dir is the record) and the Makefile no longer runs evidence_manifests check or fetch --all. No tool on dev pushes to hbox:/tank/fn/evidence, so the single-homed dependency this item names no longer exists on dev (git grep of tools, Makefile, tests at 9fe2b6a88 finds none). hbox:/tank/fn/evidence is a frozen read-only remnant, not a write path. A second site would be new machinery for a deleted mechanism; none was written.
title: The evidence archive is single-homed on hbox: while hbox is unreachable evidence_manifests add refuses (UNAVAILABLE), so no certify can be cited and every books merge stops
